attempted_claim: Let M_K be the closed hyperbolic 3-manifold obtained by (7,1) Dehn filling on the (-2,3,7)-pretzel knot complement (a fixed small-volume closed hyperbolic manifold distinct from the Weeks manifold and from figure-eight (-1,2) surgery, verified hyperbolic via SnapPy census data), and let F_d be the explicit C^2 depth-one Reebless foliation on M_K obtained by spinning the fibration surface around the unique compact quasi-Fuchsian leaf S of genus >=2 realizing the filling slope. Is F_d taut with Novikov pi_1-injectivity and R-covered leaf space, or does it contain a Reeb component or torus-leaf obstruction? The scope is this fixed pair (M_K,F_d) up to isotopy of the spinning construction. A complete answer is either a certified closed transversal meeting every leaf plus a proof that each leaf inclusion induces an injection pi_1(L)->pi_1(M_K) with no vanishing cycle and leaf space R (hence taut), or an explicit embedded Reeb torus/solid-torus component or a null-homotopic transverse vanishing-cycle loop bounding a singular disk forcing a compact genus<=1 leaf and non-tautness.
decisive_failure: originality: FAIL: exact (7,1) on (-2,3,7) spun-foliation headline not found verbatim, but substantively implied and covered as strict special case of stronger prior theorems. Given granted Reebless+C2+unique genus>=2 compact leaf plus H2=0, the conclusions follow mechanically from Novikov 1965 (Reebless=>pi1-injective, no vanishing cycles), Thurston 1986 norm minimization (null-homologous genus>=2 leaf cannot be taut), standard Dehn-filling homology, and atoroidality of closed hyperbolic manifolds, as DRAFT itself admits applies verbatim to any nonzero-meridian filling and required no computation or new theorem. Equivalent formulations (Reebless vs taut distinction, null-homologous leaf obstruction, vanishing-cycle/singular-disk language) are standard textbook material documented in Calegari, Candel-Conlon, Gabai commentary citing Roberts-Shareshian-Stein closed hyperbolic non-taut examples, and MathOverflow Reebless-but-not-taut discussion mentioning (-2,3,7) spinning. A prior source need not state the headline verbatim; substantive implication suffices, so literal-title novelty and failed exact search do not establish priority. The only potentially new component, existence/regularity of F_d, was granted not proved, so no original construction was audited. value: FAIL with ADMISSION_DEFECT. The result is a textbook restatement plus arbitrary parameter fact, not an independently retrievable advance. Specific numbers (7,1) and (-2,3,7) play no essential role beyond p!=0 and H1(N)=Z; DRAFT section 5 admits verbatim generalization to any nonzero-meridian filling. Volume/Weeks-distinction motivation unused, hyperbolicity granted not verified, R-covered target component left open, and the hard part (existence/regularity of spun C2 Reebless depth-one F_d with unique quasi-Fuchsian leaf) was assumed, so a future researcher could not reuse the precise fact without first proving the grant. The known phenomenon Reebless depth-one pi1-injective vanishing-cycle-free yet non-taut needs no new instance at one arbitrary slope. Moreover ADMISSION_DEFECT: the admitted target presupposed an exhaustive taut-with-Novikov/R-covered versus Reeb/torus/vanishing-cycle dichotomy, omitting the classical third case (Reebless non-taut rational-homology-sphere obstruction via [S]=0 / Thurston norm); the refutation exposes that framing mistake. Per TARGET policy a negative resolution that is only vacuity, cheap mismatch, direct lookup, or arbitrary parameter fact fails value even if literally false.
